claims.text: The model is compared to the R.M.-Reader + Verifier, which is more complicated and includes several components.
The model is compared to the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN), showing that the proposed joint model outperforms the SAN baseline.
The proposed model is also compared to existing machine reading comprehension systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
The extended SAN model is noted for its competitive results on the Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD) 2.0.
